changelog: Platinum hotel credit now covers Airbnb Luxe stays.

benefits.name: Uber Cash
benefits.description: Uber Cash added to your Uber account each month: $15, and $35 in December. Rides and Uber Eats orders in the US. Add the Platinum to your Uber wallet first.

benefits.name: Uber One membership
benefits.description: Covers an auto-renewing Uber One membership charged to the Platinum, up to $120 a year.

benefits.name: Digital Entertainment
benefits.description: Up to $25 back each month on one enrolled streaming or news service: Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, Paramount+, Peacock, NYT, WSJ, YouTube Premium, or YouTube TV.

benefits.name: Airline fee credit
benefits.description: Incidental fees on your one selected airline: checked bags, seat picks, in-flight snacks. Fares don't count. Pick your airline in your Amex profile each January.

benefits.name: Hotel credit
benefits.description: Up to $300 back each half on prepaid Fine Hotels + Resorts, Hotel Collection, or Airbnb Luxe stays booked through Amex Travel. Hotel Collection and Airbnb Luxe need two nights, and Fine Hotels + Resorts will too from January 2027.

benefits.name: Resy dining
benefits.description: Up to $100 back each quarter at US Resy restaurants. Dine in or takeout, paid with the Platinum.

benefits.name: Lululemon
benefits.description: Up to $75 back each quarter at US Lululemon stores and lululemon.com. Outlets don't count.

benefits.name: Saks Fifth Avenue
benefits.description: Up to $50 back each half at Saks Fifth Avenue. Amex retired this credit June 30, 2026; the first half was its last window.

benefits.name: Walmart+
benefits.description: Covers one Walmart+ monthly membership charged to the Platinum. Once it's set up, it pays itself every month.

benefits.name: CLEAR Plus
benefits.description: Covers a CLEAR Plus membership, up to $219 a year. Faster security lines at 50+ airports.

benefits.name: Oura Ring
benefits.description: Up to $200 back on Oura Ring hardware bought at ouraring.com. Once a year.

benefits.name: Equinox
benefits.description: Up to $300 back each year on Equinox club memberships or the Equinox+ app.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
benefits.description: Covers the Global Entry application fee ($120 every 4 years) or TSA PreCheck ($85 every 4.5). Global Entry includes PreCheck, so most pick that.

benefits.name: Lounge access
benefits.description: Centurion Lounges, Priority Pass, and Delta Sky Clubs when flying Delta. Guests usually $50 each unless you spend $75k a calendar year. Logged for your records, never counted against the fee.

benefits.name: Uber Cash
benefits.description: $10 in Uber Cash each month for US rides and Uber Eats. Add the Gold to your Uber wallet first.

benefits.name: Dining partners
benefits.description: Up to $10 back each month at Amex's dining partners, like Grubhub and The Cheesecake Factory.

benefits.name: Resy dining
benefits.description: Up to $50 back each half at US Resy restaurants, $100 a year.

benefits.name: Dunkin'
benefits.description: Up to $7 back each month at US Dunkin' locations. Coffee money.

benefits.name: Resy
benefits.description: Statement credit for eligible Resy restaurant purchases in the US, up to $20 each month. Pay with the Delta Reserve. Dining in or takeout booked via Resy.

benefits.name: Rideshare
benefits.description: Up to $10 back each month on US rideshare: Uber, Lyft, and others. Enroll the card first.

benefits.name: Delta Stays
benefits.description: Up to $200 back each year on prepaid hotels or vacation rentals booked through Delta Stays on delta.com.

benefits.name: Companion certificate
benefits.description: Your annual companion certificate: one round-trip domestic ticket for a travel partner, issued at renewal. Valued here at $650; taxes and fees are on you.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
benefits.description: Covers the Global Entry application fee ($120 every 4 years) or TSA PreCheck ($85 every 4.5). Global Entry includes PreCheck, so most pick that.

benefits.name: Lounge access
benefits.description: Delta Sky Club when flying Delta, plus Centurion Lounges on Delta tickets. Visit caps apply unless you spend your way to unlimited. Logged for your records, never counted against the fee.

benefits.name: Travel credit
benefits.description: $300 back on travel each account year, applied by Chase to almost anything that codes as travel: flights, hotels, transit, parking.

benefits.name: The Edit hotel credit
benefits.description: Two $250 credits on prepaid stays of two nights or more booked through The Edit by Chase Travel. Both can be used anytime in the year.

benefits.name: Select hotels credit
benefits.description: One-time for 2026: $250 back on a prepaid stay of two nights or more at select Chase Travel partners like IHG, Omni, Montage, and Pendry.

benefits.name: Exclusive Tables dining
benefits.description: Up to $150 back each half at Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables restaurants.

benefits.name: StubHub
benefits.description: Up to $150 back each half on StubHub or viagogo tickets. Activate first.

benefits.name: DoorDash promos
benefits.description: $25 in DoorDash promos each month: $5 restaurant plus two $10 non-restaurant offers. Needs the complimentary DashPass activated.

benefits.name: DoorDash dining
benefits.description: $5 off one restaurant order each month. It applies to a single order, and any unused part does not carry. Needs the complimentary DashPass activated.

benefits.name: DoorDash grocery
benefits.description: Two $10 off promos each month on non-restaurant orders: groceries, convenience, and retail like DashMart, 7-Eleven, or CVS. Each is a separate order. Needs the complimentary DashPass activated.

benefits.name: DashPass membership
benefits.description: Complimentary DashPass while enrolled: lower fees on eligible DoorDash orders. Chase pegs it at $120 a year.

benefits.name: Lyft
benefits.description: Up to $10 back each month on Lyft rides. Link the card in the Lyft app.

benefits.name: Peloton
benefits.description: Up to $10 back each month on Peloton memberships.

benefits.name: Apple TV+ & Music
benefits.description: Complimentary Apple TV+ and Apple Music while activated through Chase, about $24 a month you'd otherwise pay.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
benefits.description: Covers the Global Entry application fee ($120 every 4 years) or TSA PreCheck ($85 every 4.5). Global Entry includes PreCheck, so most pick that.

benefits.name: Lounge access
benefits.description: Priority Pass Select and Chase Sapphire Lounges. Logged for your records, never counted against the fee.

benefits.name: Hotel credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 back each account year on hotel stays booked through Chase Travel.

benefits.name: DoorDash promo
benefits.description: $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each month: grocery, convenience, retail. Needs DashPass activated.

benefits.name: DashPass membership
benefits.description: Complimentary DashPass while enrolled: lower fees on eligible DoorDash orders. Chase pegs it at $120 a year.

benefits.name: Apple TV+
benefits.description: Complimentary Apple TV+ for a year once you activate through Chase, a $156 value. Activate by Dec 31, 2026.
